items.story:
Lite-On is a Taiwan-based power electronics supplier spanning cloud power, 
optoelectronics and auto, increasingly focused on AI server power. We expect Lite-On to 
capture more of the expanding AI power electronics opportunity as execution improves, 
its customer base broadens and margins rise. Cloud power (48% of our 2026 sales
forecast) should benefit from higher content per watt alongside growth in GW of AI
hardware deployed. We forecast the AI power TAM to grow at a 69% CAGR to US
$91.2bn in 2030, supported by transitions to 400/800V DC architectures. These 
drivers underpin our above-consensus sales and earnings forecasts. We initiate coverage
with a Buy rating and NT$400 target, implying 20x 2028E EPS versus peers at 22x.
